verdict.rationale: Pylon's API and webhooks (pylon-docs-31, pylon-docs-35, pylon-docs-36) let an AI/agent programmatically create and act on issues, and triggers/automations (pylon-docs-30, pylon-docs-62) plus background agents (pylon-docs-42, pylon-docs-67) can execute workflows across accounts, which implies some capacity for scaled, automated action across many records. However, there is no explicit documentation of a bulk-operations feature (e.g., batch update/close/assign endpoints or a UI for multi-select bulk actions) — the evidence only shows single-issue/task programmatic actions and rule-based automation, not confirmed bulk processing. Missing for 10: explicit bulk API endpoints or documented bulk-edit/bulk-assign UI capability, and any independent confirmation that many items can be acted on in a single operation.
